title: Intermediate key material not zeroized in export_context
description:
File: /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore/src/edhoc/kdf.rs
Lines: 111, 115-116, 120-121, 124-125

The intermediate heapless::Vec values holding derived key material are not wrapped in Zeroizing:
- prk_out_vec (line 111)
- prk_exporter_vec (line 115-116)
- master_secret_vec (line 120-121)
- master_salt_vec (line 124-125)

heapless::Vec does not implement ZeroizeOnDrop, so when these go out of scope the key bytes remain in memory.

Fix: Either wrap in Zeroizing (if heapless::Vec implements Zeroize), or manually zeroize before drop, or refactor edhoc_kdf to write directly into a Zeroizing buffer.
close_reason: Fixed: Added explicit zeroize calls on intermediate heapless::Vec key material (prk_out_vec, prk_exporter_vec, master_secret_vec, master_salt_vec) in export_context(). Since heapless::Vec does not implement ZeroizeOnDrop, we now call .as_mut_slice().zeroize() after copying to Zeroizing arrays. Added SECURITY comment documenting the requirement.
